Edge agent edits code

Takes one trading idea from hypothesis to decision: exact rules, null benchmark, sample size, cost stress, stability and out-of-sample test. Records the result on the EDGE page.

Supervisor read-only

Reviews what other agents did: checks claims against the diff and real test runs, applies the AGENTS.md rules, returns a verdict.

Agent benchmark ready

An exam with known answers and planted traps (leakage, double costs, dirty data, ambiguous requests) that scores whether an agent really follows the rules.

Location
benchmarks/
Works in
Any agent — copy a case into a clean folder, run, grade
Status
8 cases ready; how to run is in benchmarks/README.md.
py -3 benchmarks/grade.py <run-folder>

How to add an agent

  1. Write its rules in a file: .claude/agents/<name>.md for Claude Code, and a short section in AGENTS.md so Codex finds it.
  2. Say what it may change and what it must never do.
  3. Give it a benchmark case with a known answer before trusting it.
  4. Add a card to this page (dist/agents.html).
This page lists agents defined in the project files. It cannot show live sessions — open the Claude Code sidebar or Codex for those.
